scope: Startup-inclusive closed-board S600 single-press capture with rising-RxC host observation
interpretation: The producer completes from time zero and passes reset activity, first fetch, bit transport and scenario-window checks using rising RxC. This resolves the earlier capture-window and legacy-observer gaps. It does not qualify the board: the CPU clock never reaches the required high excursion in assessed valid-supply cycles, and the clock timing screen fails. Some later supply-valid intervals lack a fresh reset interval. Digital threshold crossings and matching bit intent cannot waive these electrical failures. Host input, clock-width and receiver-margin reviews are running separately.
nextAction: Retain the pending host reviews, constrain oscillator/CPU-clock levels and timing with independently applicable device models, and require completed refinement and remaining scenario/bus/supply qualification. A successful startup-inclusive producer run alone is not acceptance.
boundary: Reference S600 and nominal unqualified device/loading assumptions; CPU/peripheral buses remain digital. No C ordinal comparison or exact U880 timing claim. Both entire simulation and saved waveform begin at zero. No specimen qualification.

waveforms.retention: Lossless local captures and producer hashes; diagnostic reviews independently verify the captures they consume.
